about_the_game:
This supporter pack offers a few thank-you's in the form of digital content to spice up your experience, and is a way to financially support our continued development!

Features the following contents:

  • A full walkthrough for all the acts as they are released

  • A couple of exclusive outfits for Arvenia usable in the new Outfit menu

  • Mastered and edited soundtracks that weren't used in-game

We might add to this as development continues, without changes in price, so all content is available whenever you'd like it!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains consensual sexual acts between the main character (the player) and the female main character. There can be some depictions of more forceful consensual scenes, depending on the choices the player makes. There is some alcohol usage present but in no circumstances does this lead to non-consensual sex.
